descriptionHtml:
Candidate N9 · proposed P1 · a new finding waiting for Quinn's confirmation, not counted yet

Android: 'Take Photo or Choose Image' and 'Photograph' open the photo picker, never the camera, even with camera permission granted

Tickets: TFA-92570 AC 3, TFA-92587 AC 3 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: local

Note: The manifest has no <queries> entry for android.media.action.IMAGE_CAPTURE, so Capacitor falls back to the file picker. Android emulator, local stack.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-13/S24, TC-09/S25

Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S18 iOS and Android debug builds on the local stack: permissions denied, offline at an AI step, empty and failure states, session end mid-dictation

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Empty patient list: a clear empty state with a way to add patients (scan or "+"). (UAT EFS state 1; TFA-94745 state 1)
  • U2 Patient with no notes yet: a clear empty state and no errors. (UAT EFS state 2; TFA-94745 state 2)
  • U3a Pre-round summary failed: the raw dictation is kept, an error is shown, and Generate stays disabled until a Save succeeds (PR #53). (UAT EFS state 3; TFA-94745 state 3; TFA-92588 AC 8 (first sentence))
  • U4a Note generation failed: "Note not generated" is shown and the dictation is kept. (UAT EFS state 4; TFA-94745 state 4)
  • U5 Billing suggestion failed: the note is still shown and the billing area shows an error. (UAT EFS state 5; TFA-94745 state 5)
  • U6 Ask AI failed: an explicit error and no invented answer. (UAT EFS state 6; TFA-94745 state 6)
  • U7 Photo capture found no patients, or the photo is unreadable: an explicit message, and nothing is added. (UAT EFS state 7; TFA-94745 state 7)
  • U8 Microphone permission denied, or the mic didn't start: an explicit message explaining how to enable it; a denied permission is handled without a crash. (UAT EFS state 8; TFA-94745 state 8; TFA-92570 AC 4)
  • U9 Offline / no network: a clear "no network" message; the dictation is kept and retried when the connection returns (OAT-03). (UAT EFS state 9; TFA-94745 state 9; TFA-92568 Eng 4)
  • U10a Session expired mid-dictation: the dictation is kept, a sign-in prompt shows, and the dictation is available after signing back in. (UAT EFS state 10; TFA-94745 state 10)
  • U13 Nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost in any failure state. (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 3)
  • U14 Every state works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android. (UAT EFS Expected Result; UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)
  • T1 Every AI call (summary, note, billing, Ask AI, photo reading, voice transcription, handoff) retries automatically before showing an error; text calls go Haiku twice, then Mistral; … (TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-92568 AC 5; UAT 3.5)
  • T4 Beyond the microphone: camera and photo-library permission prompts show a clear usage message, and a denied permission is handled without a crash (the native path into state 7). (TFA-92570 AC 4)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Android: a debug build of main bundled for the local stack on the rc_api36 emulator, driven through scripts/android-lane.ts over adb reverse (screenshots and visual checks). iOS: a Simulator debug build against the local stack. @roundai.test accounts made by make-session.ts and synthetic patients; run by a person. …

When (1) Microphone denied (Android `adb shell pm revoke com.roundcompanion.app android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO`; iOS `xcrun simctl privacy <udid> revoke microphone com.roundcompanion.app`): tap Dictate in pre-round, encounter and Ask AI; grant it again and dictate. …

Then (1) A message says how to enable the microphone in the phone's Settings; no crash; dictation works after re-enabling. (2) A clear message for the denied camera / photo library, no crash; the non-census image says no patients / residents found and the unreadable one that it couldn't be read; nothing added. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Person compares each screen with U1, U2, U3a, U4a, U5 to U10a, U13, T1 (voice audio kept until transcribed) and T4, and records the speech-to-text engine (3.9); any lost word or crash is a Fail. Whether local debug builds are acceptable evidence for UAT section 4 is Q8

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S18 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

UAT item: EFS Empty & Failure States · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: EFS/S18

iOS and Android debug builds on the local stack: permissions denied, offline at an AI step, empty and failure states, session end mid-dictation

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-92570 Mobile: Capacitor wrap for App Store & Google Play (ready for qa); TFA-92588 Pre-Rounding Summary (ready for pr); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

Detail:

Android rig: debug build of main e02167f bundled for the LOCAL stack only (bundle names 127.0.0.1:4510/4511, reached through adb reverse), built outside the checkout, on the rc_api36 emulator (Pixel 7, Android 16); Playwright attached to the app's own WebView; every ai/* action the app sends is answered or failed at the WebView's socket (no model call; aiCallLog had no new row in any run). Android half, judged 17/25 (8 fail). The account was set to the physicians' cloud engine (the shared test fixture had given it the on-device test marker), so Dictate went getUserMedia + prepareSession; prepareSession was held and failed at the WebView socket, never forwarded (no OpenAI session). PASSED: state 1 empty lists with + / scan in both contexts; state 2 a chart with no notes shows plain empty states; microphone denied at Android's prompt ('Allow Round Companion to record audio?' -> Don't allow; after two denials Android stops asking): Dictate in the pre-round editor, the encounter recorder and Ask AI, Hospital and Nursing Home, each shows 'Microphone access is blocked … open Settings › Round Companion, then tap Dictate again', keeps the typed text, no crash (6/6); granted again in Settings, Dictate gets the microphone and asks for the session (no 'blocked' message); camera denied causes no crash (3/3); offline Save Note keeps the text, and back online the save and summary finish by themselves (Q2: recorded). FAILED (8): (a) camera denied - tapping 'Take Photo or Choose Image' (Hospital / Nursing Home scan) or 'Photograph' (Previous Notes) shows no message at all, the button just does nothing (3/3); (b) camera granted - all three controls open Android's photo picker, never the camera (3/3; the manifest has no <queries> entry for the image-capture intent, so Capacitor falls back to the file picker); (c) offline at Save Note in the full-screen pre-round editor the physician sees only an endless 'Saving & Updating…' spinner and no message: the 'No network connection …' banner is rendered but hidden behind the full-screen editor (in the DOM, not on screen) until the network returns (2 checks: visible message, no endless spinner). Also seen: 'Dictation done — review before saving' next to the microphone-blocked message (known B27); the message's 'tap the lock icon in the address bar' does not apply in the app (suggestion). Rig note: airplane mode alone does not cut the emulator's adb-reverse link and Android WebView keeps navigator.onLine true, so 'offline' was made by closing the app's Convex socket (airplane mode on as well). Left for a physical phone: (3) dictating when the network drops mid-sentence, (6) the session ending mid-dictation, (7) a lock mid-dictation (real speech + live transcription), the photo-library picks (non-census / unreadable image need the live vision model), and the whole iOS half.

Product issue: On Android a physician cannot take a photo from the app: the census scan and Previous Notes 'Photograph' open the photo picker instead of the camera; if the camera permission was denied, the same buttons silently do nothing with no message saying how to allow the camera. Offline, Save Note in the full-screen pre-round editor spins 'Saving & Updating…' with no visible explanation (the no-network banner is hidden behind the editor).

Evidence: 30 attached.

Dev run: skipped: set-aside — set-aside: iOS/Android; dictation by microphone/speaker (Quinn 2026-10-14) — iOS and Android debug builds, run by a person: iOS and Android are set aside for the dev run (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
